D3.name: 当前要求适配与一致性

D4.name: 专业判断与业务可用性

within_dimension_weights: 1 per item, pending human review before scoring freeze
missing_output: dependent item=0, weights retained; evidence for existing independent items still required
multiple_output_dependencies: Determine each affected item from actual required evidence; do not zero independent satisfied content merely because another deliverable is absent
corrupt_output: Distinguish confirmed invalid Agent artifact from scorer/environment parser failure; no blanket zero
evidence_or_judge_failure: item UNSCORED; corresponding dimension and Q null; preserve known subitems; retry then human review
na: Only genuine task-inapplicability identified and approved before scoring; not missing evidence. Current drafts mark all authored items applicable.
process_errors: No extra penalty for recovered process failures, tool path, rounds, latency or skill reading
judge_blinding: Do not expose method identity, skill pack, TSR, historical scores or runs order as quality evidence; document accidental leakage
visual_and_functional: Require actual pixels/functional observations; filenames/metadata/DOM or self-claims alone insufficient
reference: No per-task historical AI reference for current 250
statistics: same task/input/rubric paired; average repeats within task; 11-category macro and 250-task micro; paired bootstrap95%CI; report coverage and pair count; keep unscored
